evidence.quote: A Zotero 7 plugin to fetch and relocate missing attachments.
ZFR will download a new PDF file but attach it to an existing PDF entry

checkNote: Pack shows no services called, no key storage, only an 'intensity' pref. Release code has no http endpoints beyond manifest URLs or apiKey references. It relocates attachments like Zotero's Find PDFs. No AI features.
